main_text.head: INDEX.
main_text.l: 12. An teneant in malos dæmones imperium, illorumque potentia fit maior dæmonū potentia.
13. An & quatenus hi angeli in animas hominū nempe intellectum & voluntatem agant.
14. An & quam vim exercere possint in corpora humana, in sensus item internos & externos.
15. Quid & quomodo agere possint in ceteras res creatas.
16. De affectibus, amore, odio, tristitia bonorum angelorum.
17. An sit vera bonorum angelorum apparitio.
18. Quas ob causas in corporibus appareant.
20. De operationibus bonorum angelorum in assumtis corporibus.
21. An omnes angeli nostras actiones obseruet.
23. An consolentur nos: item, an sint vindicæ diuinæ administri.
24. An vnius hominis vnus tatum, an vero plures sint boni angeli custodes.
25. An singulis etiā reprobis suus fit destinatus.
26. An boni angeli inter se aliquando diffideat, & disceptent.
27. An cuiuis fideli, & cuiuis prouinciæ suus vt bonus sic malus etiam decernatur angelus.
28. An omnes, an vero quidam, reliquis perpetuo in cœlo manentibus, ad ministeria allegentur.

page.notes: Several words are uncertain in the small print of this scan, notably "teneant" (likely "tenent") and "nostras" entries; the final entry "29.An" is cut off at the page foot. Page number and running head are not printed. Entries 12 to 28 are copied as numbered lines; a few words in lines 21, 22 and 27 may be imperfect.
